review_description: The installation went very well I had a 6.6 kilowatt system fitted to my roof. We were originally going to go with the Fronius Smart Meter but Venkat told us to research the Solar Analytics Meter as some people prefer that meter over the Fronius one.After, some research on SolarQuotes, we found that the Solar Analytics Meter was what we were looking for.
